prompts: Create a premium stylized 3D fantasy action RPG civilian NPC turnaround development sheet for an ORIGINAL slate stone, warm ivory, aged gold and muted teal citadel. Three full body characters, each around 1.75m height, all in the same heroic sculpted game style with slightly broad heads, expressive credible human faces, broad hands and substantial boots, natural proportions and elegant silhouettes. The merchant is a friendly mature bearded man in a short teal travel coat over a caramel quilted waistcoat, ivory shirt, split leather apron, travel satchel, visible coin pouch. The alchemist trainer is a poised older woman in a long split ivory coat, teal scarf, fitted belt carrying amber glass vials in brass clips, rounded cap with small goggles, visible articulate hands. The arena steward is a dignified middle aged dark skinned woman with short swept hair, fitted slate and ivory armored tabard, aged gold shoulder guards, a folded ledger and training baton. Each character has front, three quarter and back turnaround views in separated rows, nine complete figures total. Neutral relaxed A pose, feet grounded and fully visible, no clipped extremities. Render meaningful layered garment thickness, sculpted seams, soft worn leather, fabric roughness, restrained metal glints; sophisticated soft bevels and attractive sculpted facial anatomy. Do not use block figures, capsule heads or stick limbs. A pale warm grey studio background with even lighting and soft contact shadows. Clean practical image reference for modeling geometry, no text, no labels, no logos, no UI, no copyrighted characters. Clearly differentiated NPC role tools.

Create a premium stylized 3D fantasy action RPG architectural modular kit design contact sheet for an ORIGINAL citadel of slate stone, warm ivory limestone, aged gold brass and muted teal. Main grid is twelve distinct OPEN dungeon gateways arranged 3 columns by 4 rows, all at one consistent orthographic three-quarter camera, each about 3m wide by 3.4m tall, carved substantial masonry and practical worn edges. Each gateway has a CLEAR continuous open center passage 1.9m wide and no opaque center portal disc; original civic architecture with a physical emblem above the passage, readable silhouettes from walking-camera distance. Exact gate motifs in row-major order: 1) glass garden with leaf crown and cut glass ribs; 2) ember vault with segmented furnace keystone and small ember brazier shoulders; 3) star archive with open book crown and star astrolabe; 4) bellfall crypt with hanging bronze bell and stepped crypt lintel; 5) cinder tide lock with handwheel and paired sluice teeth; 6) nightglass observatory with crescent telescope and dark blue glass; 7) eclipse hydra vault with three wave-neck silhouettes and eclipsed disc; 8) ashforge catacomb with crossed forging hammers and anvil crown; 9) astral leviathan spire with ascending stellar fins and orbital ring; 10) verdigris sanctum with living root buttresses and patinated leaf medallion; 11) sable mirage basin with pointed dune crown and split mirror diamond; 12) comet bastion with crenellations and diagonal comet relief. Shared calm slate ivory aged gold palette with restrained route accents green, ember, ice blue, violet. These are distinct architecture beyond recoloring. In a separated bottom strip show matching modular terrain props: carved slate paving square with brass inlay, ivory low curb and stairs, low planted stone trough, teal leather bench, articulated aged gold arch lamp, teal striped merchant stall, ivory alchemy counter. No large central statue. All objects separate with negative space, full silhouettes fully visible, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no UI. Premium stylized PBR material readability and well-defined practical masonry trim, consistent warm grey studio background, restrained shadows and soft light.
